n0b8a786d39.headline: ‘Tangible progress’: SIA defends Air India investment in response to Sias
n0b8a786d39.summary: Singapore Airlines Group said it has shown tangible progress on its Air India investment in response to shareholder queries, ahead of its July 24 AGM.
n0b8a786d39.why: Singapore Airlines is a major Asian carrier, and its stakes in other airlines affect its earnings, capital allocation and shareholder relations.

nef1e0bae09.headline: Bank of Japan to keep interest rates unchanged at July meeting - Kyodo
nef1e0bae09.summary: According to people familiar with the matter cited by Kyodo, the Bank of Japan is set to keep interest rates unchanged at its July meeting and raise this year's growth forecast.
nef1e0bae09.why: The Bank of Japan sets the country's short-term policy rate, which influences the yen, Japanese government bond yields and equity valuations.
nef1e0bae09.why_moved: The report says the Bank of Japan is expected to hold rates steady while raising its growth forecast. Markets may reassess the policy path, but the input gives no price figures.

n6ccfd855f1.headline: US extends strikes on Iran to bridges and airport
n6ccfd855f1.summary: The US has expanded its air strike campaign against Iran to hit bridges and an airport, prompting retaliation, according to the report.
n6ccfd855f1.why: Strikes on Iranian infrastructure raise the risk of wider regional conflict, which can affect oil prices, shipping and risk sentiment across markets.

n1f9179c02a.headline: Analysis-Among AI crowd, some investors position for slower hyperscaler spending growth
n1f9179c02a.summary: After a parabolic rally, AI chipmakers have run into turbulence over valuations and revenue sustainability. Some investors are positioning for slower spending by hyperscalers.
n1f9179c02a.why: Hyperscalers such as large cloud providers fund the AI data-center buildout, so their capital spending plans shape demand for AI chips and servers.

n575505dd43.headline: Trump firm plans to sell priority access to Truth Social posts, possibly his own
n575505dd43.summary: Trump's media company plans to charge for special high-speed access to Truth Social posts, possibly including the president's own. The plan has been linked to national security and financial market concerns.
n575505dd43.why: Trump Media & Technology Group operates the Truth Social platform and is listed on Nasdaq, so changes to its product affect its revenue model.

nb94309ed61.headline: Most buyers of million-dollar HDB flats paid no COV in 2025: PropNex
nb94309ed61.summary: A PropNex survey finds most buyers of million-dollar HDB flats in 2025 paid no COV. Demand for such units was driven by buyers aged 30 to 49 and retirees.
nb94309ed61.why: HDB flats are Singapore's public housing, which house most of the population and form a large part of household wealth. Buyer profiles and pricing premiums signal conditions in the country's property market.

n0bf767ff05.headline: Australian Market Extends Early Losses In Mid-market
n0bf767ff05.summary: The Australian stock market extended its early losses in mid-market trade on Friday, after a relatively flat close the previous session and broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight.
n0bf767ff05.why: The S&P/ASX 200 is the benchmark index of Australia's largest listed companies and is heavily weighted toward banks and miners.

nf86268daa4.headline: Govt to release revised Index of Core Industries Series with new base year of 2022–23
nf86268daa4.summary: The DPIIT will release a revised Index of Core Industries with a new 2022-23 base year on July 20, 2026, replacing the series based on 2011-12.
nf86268daa4.why: The Index of Core Industries tracks output of key sectors such as power, steel and coal and is used to gauge India's industrial activity.

n259366fa2a.headline: US strikes bridges and collapses tower at key port as Iran campaign expands
n259366fa2a.summary: US forces carried out an early morning assault on Iranian infrastructure, including bridges and a tower at a key port, as President Donald Trump said America was winning in Iran.
n259366fa2a.why: Strikes on Iranian infrastructure affect Gulf shipping routes and oil supply risk, which feed into global energy prices.

n9cf9cb52e0.headline: Strait of Hormuz shipping traffic slows to a trickle, US gas prices rising sharply
n9cf9cb52e0.summary: Shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has nearly stopped during a week of constant strikes in the Iran war, while US gas prices are rising sharply.
n9cf9cb52e0.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil, so disruptions there quickly affect crude prices.
n9cf9cb52e0.why_moved: Near-standstill shipping through a key oil route raises fears of supply disruption, and the report says US gas prices are rising sharply.

n6be71e4082.headline: SGB investors pocket over 318% returns with exit price fixed @ ₹14,199: How much will your investment be worth?  - BusinessToday
n6be71e4082.summary: The RBI has set the premature redemption price of the SGB 2019-20 Series II at ₹14,199 per gram for investors eligible to exit after the five-year holding period.
n6be71e4082.why: Sovereign Gold Bonds are rupee-denominated securities issued by the Reserve Bank of India on behalf of the government, with value linked to gold prices.

n8498c294fc.headline: Iraq signs deals with Western oil firms, including to revive Syria pipeline
n8498c294fc.summary: Iraq signed deals with Western oil companies, including one with Chevron to rebuild a crude pipeline running from Kirkuk in Iraq to Baniyas in Syria.
n8498c294fc.why: Chevron is a major US integrated oil company, and new Iraqi oil contracts and export routes affect global crude supply and company growth.

impacts.name: Chevron
impacts.why: A new Iraqi deal and pipeline rebuild expands Chevron's regional oil activity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n540d250cf0.headline: Gina Rinehart’s estimated A$700m profit from SpaceX IPO wiped out as stock price dips - AOL
n540d250cf0.summary: Analysts say mining billionaire Gina Rinehart is unlikely to be worried by lost paper profits, after SpaceX shares dipped below their debut share price. Her estimated A$700m gain has been wiped out.
n540d250cf0.why: SpaceX is a private aerospace company whose share listing has drawn wide investor attention, and wealth tied to its valuation can shift quickly.

n49b12fad4a.headline: Pakistan secures $3 Billion Saudi Loan Rollover, eyes $6.7 Billion Oil Deal
n49b12fad4a.summary: Saudi Arabia has rolled over its $3 billion financial support to Islamabad, ensuring Pakistan's foreign exchange reserves remain intact. Reports also mention a possible $6.7 billion oil deal.
n49b12fad4a.why: Pakistan relies on Gulf financial support and imported oil, so external funding and reserve levels shape its currency stability and borrowing costs.

n9350458b59.headline: Electricity tariff likely to go up Rs1.20 per unit in Pakistan
n9350458b59.summary: The CPPA has requested an increase in electricity tariffs of about Rs1.20 per unit for June. The request is pending in Pakistan's power sector.
n9350458b59.why: Electricity tariffs affect household and industrial costs and the finances of power distributors and generators in Pakistan.

nfff0b18880.headline: Expected Petrol Price in Pakistan from July 18
nfff0b18880.summary: Pakistanis had hoped for relief, but another fuel price increase appears imminent. Global oil prices are climbing amid Middle East tensions.
nfff0b18880.why: Fuel prices feed into transport costs and inflation, and they are set by the government based on international oil price movements.

ndfd9371a3e.headline: Singapore stocks fall on Friday as local banks take a hit; STI down 0.5%
ndfd9371a3e.summary: Singapore shares fell on Friday as local banks took a hit, with the STI down 0.5%. Losers outnumbered gainers 365 to 226 across the broader market.
ndfd9371a3e.why: The Straits Times Index tracks the largest listed companies in Singapore, a major Asian financial hub. Bank stocks often carry large weight in the index.

n824c03b32d.headline: 14th S. Korean oil tanker successfully transits through Red Sea
n824c03b32d.summary: A South Korean crude oil tanker has successfully transited the Red Sea and is heading home, marking the 14th crude oil shipment to use the route, according to the ministry.
n824c03b32d.why: Red Sea shipping routes are critical for crude flows between Asia and Europe, so tanker transits signal whether energy cargoes can move despite regional risks.

n25fb29da8c.headline: Japan June core inflation seen at 1.6% on elevated energy prices: Reuters poll
n25fb29da8c.summary: Japan's core consumer inflation probably picked up in June from the previous month, a Reuters poll showed. Elevated energy prices and technical factors, including medical fee revisions, are cited.
n25fb29da8c.why: Core consumer inflation excluding fresh food is the Bank of Japan's key price gauge for setting monetary policy. It shapes expectations for interest rates and the yen.

ned0bd20bbf.headline: Malaysia's inflation slows to 1.9% in June
ned0bd20bbf.summary: Malaysia's inflation rose at a slower pace of 1.9% in June 2026, compared with 2.0% in the previous month. The figures are from the Department of Statistics Malaysia.
ned0bd20bbf.why: Consumer price inflation informs the central bank's interest rate decisions and affects the ringgit and local bond yields. It is a key indicator of the domestic economy.

n3af967af0c.headline: Stock Markets Today: Sensex, Nifty Gain on IT Stocks
n3af967af0c.summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty rallied in early trade, led by IT stocks after Tech Mahindra reported a 28.4% rise in June-quarter consolidated net profit.
n3af967af0c.why: The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty 50 are India's main equity benchmarks, and IT services firms are a major export-earning sector for the country.
n3af967af0c.why_moved: Strong buying in IT stocks followed Tech Mahindra's reported 28.4% rise in June-quarter consolidated net profit.

n1688a747c1.headline: GLOBAL MARKETS-Stocks Slump on Chip Selloff, Oil Set for Weekly Gain
n1688a747c1.summary: Chipmakers continued to drag stock indexes lower, while oil prices rose more than 11% for the week and were set for a sharp weekly gain.
n1688a747c1.why: Brent crude is the main global oil benchmark, and chipmakers are a large weight in major equity indexes such as the S&P 500.
n1688a747c1.why_moved: A chip selloff dragged stock indexes lower, while oil prices rose more than 11% over the week.

nea9026a159.headline: Asian shares sink, with Tokyo down nearly 5%
nea9026a159.summary: Tokyo's Nikkei 225 fell 5% as heavy selling of computer chipmakers and other AI-related shares dragged Asian markets lower. The move was part of a wider regional sell-off.
nea9026a159.why: The Nikkei 225 is Japan's benchmark stock index, and it includes major chip-equipment and technology companies.

impacts.name: Nikkei 225
impacts.why: The index fell about 5% as heavy selling of chipmakers and AI-related shares dragged markets lower.

nea9026a159.why_moved: Heavy selling of computer chipmakers and other AI-related shares dragged the market lower.

n91325e79ac.headline: Chinese airlines expect billions in losses
n91325e79ac.summary: China's three major airlines expect heavy losses after first-half losses, facing elevated fuel costs and softening travel demand. Their joint announcement came ahead of the peak summer travel season.
n91325e79ac.why: Major Chinese carriers such as Air China, China Eastern and China Southern are large listed airlines whose results depend heavily on fuel costs and demand.

n6b2907680e.headline: Trump’s fiery China allegations may threaten superpower truce
n6b2907680e.summary: Trump renewed accusations that China meddled in US elections, which could complicate the fragile superpower truce. China has responded to the allegations.
n6b2907680e.why: US-China relations shape tariffs, export controls and supply chains that affect global trade and corporate earnings. Renewed tensions can move equity, currency and commodity markets.

n09d5d6c323.headline: Network School puts RM500mil investment in Malaysia on hold, seeks meeting with PM Anwar
n09d5d6c323.summary: Network School has put a planned RM500mil expansion in Malaysia on hold. Its founder says the company will not proceed without assurances that the Forest City campus controversy will not recur.
n09d5d6c323.why: Large foreign investment commitments affect Malaysia's investment pipeline and the perception of its business climate. Investors watch such decisions as indicators of policy stability.

nd3ccbcd36e.headline: Petrol and Diesel Prices Likely to Increase Today
nd3ccbcd36e.summary: Petrol and diesel prices are expected to rise in the upcoming fortnightly fuel price review, with high-speed diesel likely to see the sharpest increase.
nd3ccbcd36e.why: Fuel prices influence transport costs, inflation and government fuel subsidy decisions in Pakistan. Changes in the fortnightly review reflect movements in global oil product prices.

nfd885a626c.headline: Japanese Market Sharply Lower; Slipping 3%
nfd885a626c.summary: The Japanese market traded sharply lower on Friday, extending heavy losses from the prior session after broadly negative overnight cues from Wall Street.
nfd885a626c.why: The Nikkei 225 is Japan's benchmark equity index, tracking large exporters and domestic blue chips that drive global sentiment toward Japanese assets.
nfd885a626c.why_moved: The market extended the previous session's losses, following negative cues from Wall Street overnight.

n4d2934bbb1.headline: Pakistan’s Solar Boom Reaches 7,000 MW as Govt Moves to Replace Net Metering
n4d2934bbb1.summary: Pakistan's rooftop solar capacity has grown nearly 37-fold over six years to almost 7,000 MW by June 2026, prompting the government to move to replace net metering.
n4d2934bbb1.why: Net metering rules determine how rooftop solar owners are compensated for power they feed into the grid, shaping investment returns in distributed renewable energy.

n8e03ba5925.headline: Petrol, Diesel Prices Likely to Rise in Next Review
n8e03ba5925.summary: Petrol and high-speed diesel prices in Pakistan could increase in the next fortnightly petroleum review. Estimates point to Rs6.60 per litre for petrol and Rs5.27 per litre for diesel, pending government approval.
n8e03ba5925.why: Pakistan reviews fuel prices fortnightly, and changes pass quickly into transport costs, inflation and the central bank's policy calculations.

nf7d5f62947.headline: Petrol price in Pakistan - July 2026
nf7d5f62947.summary: The government's decision will raise the petrol price in Pakistan by Rs5 per litre. The report did not give further details on the reasons for the change.
nf7d5f62947.why: Petrol is a regulated fuel in Pakistan, so government price decisions feed directly into transport costs and inflation.

neef84407fc.headline: SBI Acquires Singaporean Crypto Exchange Coinhako After MAS Approval
neef84407fc.summary: SBI Holdings received regulatory approval to acquire a majority stake in Singapore-based crypto exchange Coinhako. The deal expands SBI's presence in stablecoins, onchain finance and tokenization.
neef84407fc.why: SBI Holdings is a Japanese financial group with a growing crypto and digital-asset business, and Singapore is a major regulated hub for crypto firms.
